description: Fork of exp475 (bs=16, 1.4962 @ 8K). SINGLE change: device_batch_size 16->48, total_batch_size 8192->24576 (grad_accum=1, physical batch 48 seqs). 3x effective batch, 3x token budget over the same 8000 steps. Batch-scaling test at the 89.4M exp475 shape — batch scaling has been the dominant lever in tiny LUT-LM (exp348 bs=48=1.5234 vs exp340 bs=16=1.6366 at the smaller shape). Everything else identical to exp475 (mean-abs norm, LION beta=(0.9,0.95), lut_lr=2e-4, soft backward, 8K steps).
